SELECT * FROM multiremi_agents WHERE id = ? AND archived_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM multiremi_agents WHERE id = ?

SELECT runtime.*, profile.display_name AS daemon_display_name FROM multiremi_runtimes runtime LEFT JOIN multiremi_daemon_profiles profile ON profile.workspace_id = COALESCE(runtime.workspace_id, 'local') AND profile.daemon_id = runtime.daemon_id WHERE runtime.id = ?
